tasks.title: Publish validated location uptime and bounded JSON mutations in contract 2.2.0
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Behavior and Checks bullets, Tool facts and Completion evidence; Decisions 1, 3 and 10; Contract fields; Counterexamples (Statistic, Sorting and uniqueness, Outcome classes); Security impact. Keep these additive exports in one contract 2.2.0 release with wire version 1. Implement location schemas/types and the same-object nonthrowing validator, and requestJson POST/PUT/DELETE with bounded ErrorResponse.error text and response metadata captured as soon as headers arrive. Preserve metadata through body-read failures and interruption, return http without message for oversized non-2xx bodies, and never follow redirects or retry. Preserve fetchJson behavior and its existing HTTP error shape at runtime; the shared FetchJsonError type only gains the optional message field required by requestJson. Export RequestJsonResponse alongside the other new types, update the type fixture and docs, and rebuild/commit dist.

acceptance.expected: All selected tests pass, 0 fail; focused coverage may fail the global threshold. Literal eu {good:4,results:5,uptime:80} and us {good:0,results:0,uptime:null} pass; duplicate/unsorted names, windowDays 30, negative/fractional counts, good 4/results 3 and inconsistent nulls fail. The validator returns the original object without throwing. Fake fetch/schedule checks prove method/body/content-type/redirect manual, 201 JSON, 204/empty body with value undefined, raw ETag, 412 ErrorResponse text, 500 non-JSON without message, 302 http with response.status 302, validation/JSON/wire failures and exactly 1 fetch per case. Timeout/network/abort before headers gives response null; timeout/abort during a 201 body retains response.status 201. A 200 with ETag '"sha256-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"' and maxBytes+1 body gives too-large with response {status:200,etag:'"sha256-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"',wire:{status:'ok'}}; oversized 422 gives http 422 with no message, never too-large. Wire 2 on 2xx gives wire-mismatch and response.status; missing wire on 201 succeeds with wire absent. Error text is bounded to 1000 characters using own data properties only. Existing fetchJson tests pass and its http errors have no message. The 412 error message is the literal 'the configuration changed: reload it and retry'; empty successful bodies skip validation, and error-text boundary tests assert 1000 characters maximum without executing getters or accepting inherited error properties.

exit 0; lint, build, type fixture and full tests pass at the existing 80% line coverage gate. CheckLocationUptime, LocationUptime, RequestJsonOptions, RequestJsonResult and RequestJsonResponse compile as public exports; package version 2.2.0 and WIRE_VERSION 1. PR evidence includes check output, new tests failing on 9ab7e24 for missing exports, and their passing counterparts.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after the regenerated dist artifacts have been staged or committed; rebuilding produces no unstaged dist drift. Record the Security impact checklist evidence applicable to the library: own-data error properties, response cap default 5242880 bytes, error-text bound 1000 characters, no redirects/retries and no added runtime dependency. Include the check and build output in the PR.
